Titles.eng: Naruto the Movie: Legend of the Stone of Gelel
Titles.jpn: 劇場版 NARUTO -ナルト- 大激突!幻の地底遺跡だってばよ

Summaries.eng: At a desolated beach, a night-time battle rages between the sand ninjas and bulky, robot-like, armored warriors. Gaara and the group of sand ninjas gain the upper-hand and when the remaining warriors begin to retreat back into the ocean, they shoot flares into the night to reveal a large warship waiting just offshore.
